subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor ou já com certa autonomia, listas, agendas, calendários, avisos, convites, receitas, instruções de montagem (digitais ou impressos), dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto e relacionando sua forma de organização à sua finalidade.

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender colaborativamente gêneros de lista e agenda do dia a dia considerando sua situação comunicativa
components.description_en: Read and comprehend collaboratively list and agenda genres from everyday life considering their communicative situation

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender colaborativamente avisos, convites e calendários conectando sua estrutura ao propósito
components.description_en: Read and comprehend collaboratively notices, invitations, and calendars connecting their structure to their purpose
components.cc_component_description: Explain how an author uses text structure to clarify connections between scientific concepts

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender colaborativamente gêneros procedimentais como receitas e instruções de montagem considerando seu tema
components.description_en: Read and comprehend collaboratively procedural genres such as recipes and assembly instructions considering their topic
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between explanatory, procedural, and experimental purposes in science and technical texts

components.description_pt: Relacionar a estrutura organizacional de gêneros do dia a dia ao seu propósito comunicativo
components.description_en: Connect the organizational structure of everyday-life genres to their communicative purpose
components.cc_component_description: Identify the organizational structure used in an informational text

cc_matches.description: Analyze the structure of the relationships among concepts in a text, including relationships among key terms (e.g., force, friction, reaction force, energy).
Analyze the author's purpose in providing an explanation, describing a procedure, or discussing an experiment in a text, identifying important issues that remain unresolved.
Compare and contrast the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in two or more texts.
